title.narrative: Health support in response to COVID-19 in Timor-Leste

description.narrative: Overall objective: To mitigate the health impact of communicable diseases, and particularly of COVID-19, and contribute to building a strong, effective and resilient health system in Timor-Leste. Specific Objectives: 1) To mount effective COVID-19 response operations that are gender responsive and inclusive of all, participatory, transparent and accountable;2) To strengthen the capacity of testing, detecting and monitoring COVID-19 cases;3) To reduce the risks of adverse impacts on morbidity and mortality including from other health issues;4) To improve access to timely availability of technical experts, PPE, diagnostics equipment, other medical and non-medical items required for the prevention and mitigation of COVID-19.
